pages.en:
The search ends easily.

Lancer may appear specialized entirely for combat, but in truth, he is a Servant well versed in magecraft.

The power he learned in the enchanted fortress called the Land of Shadows was not limited to the “piercing thing” known as Gae Bolg.

He is a hero who mastered all eighteen of the primordial runes.

However, because the man himself prefers fighting with his spear to working magecraft, those mysteries seldom see the light of day.

Today is one of those rare occasions.

But since he prefers to battle using his lance, the magic rarely gets used.
And now is one of the rare times.

“Oh—yeah. Sorry, brat. My hand moved before my mouth did.”

Apparently it was only because he acted unconsciously that he avoided killing the boy.

If Rin Tohsaka had been any paler, or if her clothes had been disordered by so much as another inch, the act would not have been unconscious. Lancer would deliberately have delivered the retaliation the situation deserved.

To be clear, Lancer cares nothing for how prisoners are treated.

What matters is whether someone else has laid claim to his quarry.

And to Lancer, quarry naturally divides into enemies worth killing and women who have caught his favor.
